THE PRACTICAL PART

Refill. Clean. Repeat.

Release three accessible crown catches after lowering feeder; lift crown and refill mesh cup. Large portals permit shallow tray filling.

The original notes call for whole sunflower seed and a shallow fill; fine seed may escape the mesh. This is a feeder, not an enclosed birdhouse.

What you need

A suitable printer, compatible filament, and appropriate outdoor suspension hardware. The integral eye suspends the assembled feeder; the cord or support is not a printed part. No camera, batteries, app or subscription are needed.

Supplied 3MF filament type: PETG. ASA is an outdoor alternative, not a drop-in profile substitution: change the profile, re-slice and test the fit. Use manufacturer ventilation guidance.

Download editable source ZIP

Assembly sequence

  1. Press mesh basket into basin socket until its two detents click.
  2. Align the three lower shelter receivers over basin hooks; press evenly until every catch is visible through its window.
  3. Press hanging crown onto upper shelter hooks; verify three visible catches. Hang the rigid assembly only by the integral top eye.
  4. For refill lower feeder and release crown hooks through external windows. For cleaning release basin hooks and squeeze basket detents inward.

Before hanging it outdoors

  • R2 digital PETG prototype. Four physical parts, four or fewer colors. Exterior relief is 0.8–1.0 mm; all decorative lines at least 1.6 mm wide.
  • Single integral 10 mm-ID top hanger carries assembled rigid feeder through positive snap joints. Use one external suspension line only. No ropes retain components.
  • Structural joints: three accessible 1.6 mm-thick cantilever beams, 22 mm overall length (19 mm free), 0.7 mm undercut, 0.30 mm nominal clearance. Physically fit-test PETG coupon and proof-load before hanging.
  • Printed mesh basket is removable; no clear plastic or purchased reservoir. Use whole sunflower seed, shallow fill; very fine seed can escape mesh.
  • Drain holes 2.2 mm. Open portals permit brushing; detach crown and basin to clean. Do not glue snap joints.

Use shallow daily portions, remove wet seed, keep drains open, and inspect joints and suspension points. Test near the ground before installing over people, pets or property.
